subject.title: improve(qa): align Telegram coverage with startup behavior

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114055 lands, should this Telegram coverage branch be rebased onto main and merged only after refreshed smoke-selection proof succeeds?
rationale: The proposed behavior is deliberately split across two active branches, so only maintainers can accept the sequencing and final merge-tree evidence as the intended QA ownership boundary.

options.title: Land parent, then refresh this PR
options.body: Merge the execution-profile refactor first, rebase this PR onto main, and require refreshed focused Telegram and smoke-profile proof before merging.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep both PRs open until maintainers want to reconsider whether the taxonomy and scenario-pack ownership refactor should proceed.

recommendation.title: Land parent, then refresh this PR
recommendation.body: Merge the execution-profile refactor first, rebase this PR onto main, and require refreshed focused Telegram and smoke-profile proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active two-PR QA stack and can prepare the post-parent rebase and focused proof.
